entities.summary: Rosina Wachtmeister is an Austrian artist, whose work includes cat sculptures and portraits. Her family moved to Brazil when she was 14, and she later graduated from the University of Porto Alegre in Brazil. Her Das Lied von der Liebe is a book whose graphics illustrate the biblical Song of Songs.
